newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks, bonds tumble at open amid jitters.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks, bonds tumble at open amid jitters.

text.p: The Dow industrials tumbled more than 90 points to 6381 within 15 minutes of the U.S. stock market opening, prompting the New York Stock Exchange to set curbs on index-arbitrage orders at 1436 GMT.
The S&P 500 shed 10 points to 737. Losers trounced gainers nine to one on NYSE volume of about 42 million shares.
The long bond shed more than one point to yield 6.57 percent, despite friendly wholesale inflation data Wednesday morning.
Analysts said Wall Street was beset by several unsubstantiated rumors at a time when it had rebounded swiftly after stiff selling last Friday.
